title: Ultrahuman app film
description: A white section with a centred app intro (40px title, two grey lines, two outline store pills with icons) above a rounded film frame: 800×450 on desktop, a tall 266×473 portrait on phones, with a soft round play button in the corner. Title, copy, pills and frame rise in as they scroll into view.
notes: the play button is chrome only: wire it to your own player
